question: Which complete downstream modules transform the post-cue MLP8 Down-output component initially orthogonal to temporal Q8 into the final shared-Q8 state and is/was behavior?

frozen_design.population: The same 29 jointly capable fresh-v6 A1/A2 rows. The post-cue positions, Q8 basis, MLP8 hidden-product difference, and rank-8 Down-row-space complement are frozen from the released v2 null.
frozen_design.actuation: Install only the MLP8 post-cue hidden-product complement orthogonal to row(S^T W_Down) into an otherwise native base run.
frozen_design.sites: Every complete attention and MLP response in layers 9 through 17. Attention is clamped at the full pre-c_proj vector so the native c_proj is retained; MLP is clamped at its complete output. Clamp all causal positions through the final query.
frozen_design.arms: Eighteen leave-one-response removals, one joint all-site removal, and one base self-clamp identity, always under the same frozen complement actuation.
frozen_design.materiality: A site is stable material only if removing it accounts for at least 10% absolute complement behavior and at least 10% final-Q8 coordinate norm in both A1 and A2.

predictions.pred_a_authority_replay_self_clamp_finit: Hashes, 29-row identity, complement replay, native base self-clamp, finite metrics, complete site inventory, and price pass.
predictions.pred_b_at_least_one_stable_material_conv: At least one complete module meets the frozen behavior-and-Q8 materiality rule in both panels.
predictions.pred_c_joint_downstream_responses_mediat: Joint removal accounts for at least 80% absolute complement behavior and 80% final-Q8 coordinate norm in both panels.
predictions.pred_d_converter_removal_is_directionall: The top stable site's removed behavior has positive cosine at least 0.70 with the live complement effect in both panels.
predictions.pred_e_zero_fit_complete_inventory: All eighteen modules are tested without fit, gradients, head selection, or model updates.

decision: A screen licenses head splitting for a top attention converter or Down/product splitting for a top MLP converter. If only the joint arm is material, run prospective greedy complete-module removal. If neither is material, follow the residual/normalization route instead.
